name: classroom
notes: Room for components/ClassroomRing.jsx. To swap the room, replace the SVG files and this JSON; no code change. Per layer: file (relative to this folder), z (drawing order; layers with z > ringZ are drawn in front of the boards and fade out while zoomed), parallax (px the layer shifts per degree of ring rotation), tileAspect (SVG width / height; the layer is scaled to its height and repeated horizontally), top / bottom / height (CSS lengths inside the stage).
